text: Plan RM-006 through RM-010 and RM-045 from docs/campaigns/campaign-brief/spec/SPEC.md, then review the frozen contract and Campaign Brief before execution.

Planning only in this session: do not register an execution contract or supervise implementation. Keep operator-brief.md as the running-campaign continuity capsule. Use the measured typecheck/check suite in control/verification.json; the full npm test exceeds a single contract verification command limit.
Roadmap Q2: confirm two separate names, operator-brief.md for continuity and campaign-brief.md for pre-execution approval; proposed answer is yes.
Confirm first sharing surface: proposed initial release is a self-contained local HTML file plus Markdown source with a stable path; external publication or PR comment is a later explicit action.

When the detached planning pipeline reaches frozen or contested, inspect plans/approval-surface/plan.json and contract.json, check requirement coverage and scope closure, and resolve any findings before registering an execution contract. Do not supervise implementation yet.
Keep two names: operator-brief.md remains the small continuity capsule for a running campaign; campaign-brief.md is the pre-execution approval artefact. Do not merge their purposes.
The owner chose two names: operator-brief.md is the model-free continuity capsule for an active campaign; campaign-brief.md is the pre-execution approval artefact.
First release: a portable self-contained mdhtml file plus a minimal loopback-only web server that opens the generated document in a local browser. No external publication or automatic PR comment.
The owner chose portable mdhtml output and a minimal local web server for browser access. The .md.html file itself must still open offline without any server.

The first detached plan was stopped while collecting repository facts, before any planning run or model invocation, because R8 local browser access was added by the owner. The revised spec is v1.1.0; planning will restart from it.

Retomado o run de revisão approval-surface-revise-3 após stall, mantendo codex-cli 0.154.0; CODEX_VERSION foi removida apenas do ambiente do comando porque o probe a mascarava no banner de versão. O run voltou a running (tentativa 2). Na inspeção independente do rascunho, a pipeline usa phase approval-surface para todos os nós, mas as declarações de requisitos têm phase-brief-source/review/sharing: assim o congelamento não carimbaria requirementIds nos nós. Resolver esse descompasso e substituir provas de comportamento do tipo path por command antes de aceitar o contrato.

Após o run revise-3 terminar, ler o output revisado e resolver os achados do reviewer; antes do freeze, corrigir a associação entre as fases declaradas e o campo phase dos nós para que R1-R8 sejam carimbados nos nós responsáveis, validar provas de comportamento por comando, conferir o contrato com Faberun e só então apresentar os caminhos do plano e contrato para aprovação humana. Não executar o contrato.

Owner requests an independent Claude Opus worker critique of the Campaign Brief spec and iterative improvement until reviewer and operator agree. This supersedes the previous next action to freeze the implementation plan immediately; critique and revise spec first, then revisit planning. Do not execute the implementation contract.

Claude Opus 5 spec-review run campaign-brief-plan-spec-critique-spec-review-1 completed with 12 findings. Revised SPEC.md to v1.2.0 in commit 4c1c5d5: pinned spec identity, explicit coverage gaps, capacity-aware graph, five-sample estimation rule with measured verification provenance, external mdhtml v1.1.3 provisioning/failure behavior, per-phase artifact path, and separate loopback server. The finding that frozen nodes never carry requirement ids was corrected against stampPhaseRequirementIds; the 100-node measurement is present in sizing.mjs. A second Opus review will test remaining objections before the implementation plan is frozen.

Inspect Claude Opus review-2 for SPEC.md v1.2.0. Resolve remaining material findings, including plan metadata integrity and stale HTML after failed rebuild if still open; repeat Opus review until no material objections. Only then regenerate/freeze the P1 implementation plan against the revised spec. Do not execute it.

The approval-surface draft/review/revise planning runs used SPEC.md v1.1.0 and cannot be frozen for execution after the v1.2.0 Opus critique. Their revise output also maps all R1-R8 onto one phase, uses path proofs for behavior, and proposes an npm mdhtml dependency that resolves to an unrelated package. A fresh plan is required after spec consensus.

Claude Opus 5 review-2 returned eight remaining findings. SPEC.md v1.3.0 (ed84ab5) resolves them: project/90-day execution sample pool and historical measured durations, pinned plan/spec bytes for local routes, explicit generate/serve verbs, real mdhtml acceptance proof, freeze proof in test/plan, decision-state predicate, server refusal before URL. Operator additionally required a plan digest sidecar, a real phase-to-node fixture, and stale HTML invalidation. Third Opus review is running.

Claude Opus 5 review-3 found two real blockers in SPEC.md v1.3.0: pipeline drops plan phases and rewrites plan.json after freeze. SPEC.md v1.4.0 (f58a701) requires internal node phases carried through planner/freeze, and plan.json.sha256 over final status/approved bytes. Strict spec validation, docs links and diff check pass. Fourth Opus critique is detached.

Implementar a campanha campaign-brief até o fim: gerar e congelar o plano de implementação, executar todas as fases, usar worker zcode-glm com glm-5.3-flash e judge codex-gpt com gpt-5.6-sol, corrigir falhas e promover o resultado na branch da campanha.
Use zcode-glm-flash (glm-5.3-flash) for workers and codex-sol (gpt-5.6-sol) as judge; catalogue at docs/campaigns/campaign-brief/control/runtimes.json; implement spec v1.5.0 through final gates.

Allow the codex-sol judge workspace-write sandbox so the Faberun worker-result protocol can persist review.json in the isolated review worktree; keep the judge model gpt-5.6-sol and no product writes.

Plan for phase implementation-r2 is contested after 2 review round(s): The final `npm test` gate is assigned `timeoutSec: 120` even though repo-facts has no measurement for that command and records two included subsets at 178904 ms (`node --test test/cli`) and 246955 ms (`node --test test/engine`). Because the package test script runs all `test/*/*.test.mjs`, this timeout is already below measured constituent-suite durations, so the terminal node can time out on a correct implementation and cannot prove R8's required full regression gate.; nodes[0].taskPacket.readFiles[10] does not exist: test/plan/pipeline.test.mjs; Node brief-render-html no longer declares src/report/campaign-brief-render.mjs in writeFiles, which the plan this revise revised did declare, and no other node in the revised plan declares it either. Declare it again on whichever node owns the work: the resolution to a scope-closure finding is to declare or acknowledge the dragged-along file, never to drop a write the node needs — a smaller write set clears the same finding while leaving the worker unable to do the work.
